title: The Brothers' War Promos: card flavor text

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: One of the brothers whose rivalry drove the war; prince consort whose research was funded by Yotia's coffers.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Urza's brother, whose desperation to destroy him let Gix destroy him instead.

entities.name: Gix
entities.description: A being who pierces his disciples' minds to take their knowledge and who destroyed Mishra.

entities.name: Ashnod
entities.description: An artificer who devised a solution for the transmogrants and sent the sylex to Urza via Tawnos.

entities.name: Tawnos
entities.description: An artificer who built the Stasis Coffin and was tasked with bringing the sylex to Urza.

entities.name: Tocasia
entities.description: The brothers' mentor figure, who paid the price for their enmity.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A time-traveling figure (a planeswalker) whose spirit traveled through time with Kaya's help.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: A planeswalker who helped Teferi's spirit travel through time.

entities.name: Loran of the Third Path
entities.description: A scholar who saw the sylex as a key to the past.

entities.name: Kayla bin-Kroog
entities.description: Figure associated with the vision of rebuilding a continent.

entities.name: Drafna
entities.description: Scholar who with his wife Hurkyl built a legacy of scholarship lasting millennia.

entities.name: Hurkyl
entities.description: Drafna's wife and fellow scholar.

entities.name: Ani
entities.description: An Urzan soldier.

entities.name: Myrel
entities.description: Urzan commander titled Shield of Argive who fought the Argothians.

entities.name: Hajar
entities.description: Mishra's loyal bodyguard who has stood by him from the beginning.

entities.name: Harbin
entities.description: A pilot who claims Yotia as his birthright and asks his father to let him fight.

entities.name: Sharaman
entities.description: An Urzan lieutenant.

entities.name: Gaea
entities.description: Nature deity in whose name fallen friends blossom again.

entities.name: Seven brass gods
entities.description: Gods invoked by Sharaman.

entities.name: Transmogrants
entities.description: Creatures bearing the faces of Fallaji soldiers' loved ones.

entities.name: Sylex
entities.description: A device whose blast ended the war and Dominaria as most knew it.

entities.name: The Stasis Coffin
entities.description: A coffin built by Tawnos to be impermeable to forces inside and out.

entities.name: The Antiquities War
entities.description: An in-world history of the war.

entities.name: Fallaji
entities.description: People whose soldiers fought on Mishra's side.

entities.name: Argothians
entities.description: Defenders of Argoth.

entities.name: Thran
entities.description: Ancient civilization whose machines lay dormant.

entities.name: Kroog
entities.description: A city left in ruins.

entities.name: Yotia
entities.description: Nation whose coffers funded Urza's research.

entities.name: Argoth
entities.description: Forest land ravaged by war that slowly recovered after hibernation.

entities.name: Argive
entities.description: Realm Myrel shields.

entities.name: Lat-Nam
entities.description: Seat of scholarship founded by Drafna.

entities.name: Terisiare
entities.description: Continent whose mines ran dry during the war.

entities.name: Tomakul
entities.description: Destination of Urza's fortified path.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane changed by the sylex blast.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: Nightmare that returned after five thousand years.

entities.name: The Brothers' War
entities.description: The war between Urza and Mishra.

events.summary: Teferi's spirit travels back through time with Kaya's help.
events.quote: Teferi's body couldn't travel through time far enough, but with Kaya's help, his spirit could.

events.summary: Gix absorbs his disciples' knowledge by piercing their minds.
events.quote: Gix pierced his disciples' minds and savored their experiences as he took in their knowledge.

events.summary: Ashnod hands the sylex to Tawnos to deliver to Urza.
events.quote: "Get the sylex to Urza at any cost. Tell him to fill it with memories of the land."

events.summary: Gix destroys Mishra, exploiting his desperation.
events.quote: In Mishra's desperation to destroy his brother, he allowed Gix to destroy him instead.

events.summary: Ashnod devises a solution to Fallaji soldiers' distress at transmogrants.
The brothers' rivalry becomes enmity and Tocasia pays the price.
events.quote: The brothers' rivalry escalated into all-out enmity, and Tocasia paid the price.

events.summary: The Argothians awaken the land itself against Myrel's forces.
events.quote: We didn't expect the ground itself to stand.

events.summary: Phyrexia returns after five thousand years.
events.quote: After five thousand years, the nightmare returned.

events.summary: Urza fortifies the path to Tomakul, creating trenches traded for decades.
events.quote: Urza fortified every thirty miles on the path to Tomakul

events.summary: The sylex blast ends the war and Dominaria as most knew it.
events.quote: The sylex blast marked not only the end of the war, but the end of Dominaria as most knew it.

events.summary: Argoth slowly recovers after a long hibernation.
events.quote: After a long hibernation, Argoth began slowly recovering from the ravages of war.
